title: I bought the most Popular Gravel Endurance bike from Eurobike - Lightcarbon

takeaways.text: About US$700 for frame, fork, seatpost and integrated bar when he saw it at Eurobike; ordering is by email from an OEM that he suspects also supplies big brands.
The seatpost head uses a strong two-bolt clamp but the bolts need a ball-end or cut-down key; rail adapters for metal and carbon rails are included.
The bottom bracket is T47 86.5 mm, faced after moulding with immaculate threads; brake mounts and dropouts are faced and the headset seats (52 mm both ends) are very clean.
The cast-aluminium down-tube storage door and its reinforced opening add considerable weight, a design compromise; it locks with a cam.
The sectioned reject shows an EPS-moulded front triangle with no voids at section changes, a bladder-moulded rear triangle bonded on, and two aluminium bottom-bracket inserts machined after moulding.

disclosure: Hambini says he bought the frameset after seeing it at Eurobike; a cutaway frame used for inspection was a reject with a machining defect, not a customer frame.
summary: Engineer's inspection of a LightCarbon LCR018-D frameset and a sectioned production reject showing its construction.
